items.title_en: This Secret Pencil Shop In Baghdad Boasts 1 Million Stunning Designs | Watch
items.summary_zh: 来自印度的 Ankita Kumari 在巴格达发现了一家独特的铅笔店，拥有 100 万支铅笔，店主为 Ali Al Mandlawi。这家店已经营业了40年
items.summary_en: Ankita Kumari from India found a unique pencil shop in Baghdad with 1 million pencils, owned by Ali Al Mandlawi. The shop has been operating for the last 40 years
